title: Understanding Model Complexity
text: When you reduce the number of features in a model, you are simplifying it. Think about how this might affect the model's ability to fit the training data versus its ability to generalize to new data.

title: Training Error vs. Validation Error
text: Consider what happens to the training error and validation error when a model becomes less complex. Why might the training error increase while the validation error decreases?

title: Model Variance
text: What happens to the variance of a model when you reduce the number of features?
